neighborhoods.name: Giudecca
neighborhoods.description: Isola separata dal Canal della Giudecca, tranquilla e quasi priva di turisti. Viste mozzafiato su Venezia, hotel di lusso storici (Cipriani) e atmosfera da borgo marinaro. Collegata con il vaporetto in 5 minuti.
neighborhoods.description_en: Island separated by the Giudecca Canal, peaceful and almost tourist-free. Breathtaking views of Venice, historic luxury hotels (Cipriani) and a fishing village atmosphere. Connected by vaporetto in 5 minutes.
neighborhoods.description_fr: Île séparée par le canal de la Giudecca, paisible et presque sans touristes. Vues à couper le souffle sur Venise, hôtels de luxe historiques (Cipriani) et atmosphère de village de pêcheurs. Reliée par vaporetto en 5 minutes.

es.name: Giudecca
